## Summary

Describe the problem and the focused change that solves it.

## Verification

List the commands, tests, and documentation checks you ran.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover observable behavior changes.
- [ ] Ruff lint and formatting checks pass.
- [ ] Public API or behavior changes are documented.
- [ ] No credentials, private prompts, or generated benchmark output are included.
- [ ] The change preserves Python 3.12 and 3.13 support.
